source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-38

procedures.title: Power steering hoses: install
steps: On the Corvette, always fit the hoses with the front wheels straight ahead.
Avoid any needless twisting of the hoses while fitting them.
notes: Misrouted hoses can chafe or be damaged in sharp turns.
Caution: never start the engine with any power steering hose disconnected.
Figure 67 in the manual includes a Corvette view of the hose routing between pump and control valve.
